explained.tdh.overview.meta.title: Total Days Held · 6529 Explained
explained.tdh.overview.meta.description: What TDH is, what it is for, and how it is checked every day.
explained.tdh.overview.title: Total Days Held
explained.tdh.overview.lede: Every card you hold adds its rate for each whole day held, one boost multiplies the total, and the result weighs your votes on the next Meme card.
explained.tdh.overview.machine.label: One copy, as an area
explained.tdh.overview.machine.copiesMin: {minted} minted so far · counts as {edition} · CC0
explained.tdh.overview.machine.sold: {sold} The days leave with the copy: the buyer starts at zero, and its first whole day counts a day after it arrives.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.label: The picture
explained.tdh.overview.picture.title: A copy's TDH is an area.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.body: Its {days} are the width. Its card's {rate} is the height: {h}, the largest Meme edition, divided by the card's own edition, so rarer cards stand taller. One {boost} lays a band across everything you hold.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.captionLe: Every edition has the same area.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.caption: A card's copies together add about {h} TDH a day before boosts, whatever its size, so each new card adds about the same to the network. Real editions from 6529.io, read {read}.
explained.tdh.overview.network.label: Everyone's TDH
explained.tdh.overview.network.title: The network is one area too, and it is not spread evenly.
explained.tdh.overview.network.aria: Today's TDH as one area, split by rank: the top identities' share of the total, and their share of the identities.
explained.tdh.overview.network.caption: The top {count} identities hold {share} of today's TDH. Each identity's TDH from 6529.io's public API, read hourly; together they sum to {sum} TDH. An identity is one to four linked wallets, not always one person.
explained.tdh.overview.network.unavailab: 6529.io's API did not answer, so this figure is not drawn.
explained.tdh.overview.weight.label: What it is for
explained.tdh.overview.weight.title: Your TDH is your weight here.
explained.tdh.overview.weight.body: TDH is not money. You cannot send it or spend it, and voting does not use it up. It is how much say your collection gives you, and only holding earns it: the art itself is {cc0}, free for anyone to use.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.votesBody: The community chooses each new Meme card on Main Stage, three times a week. Your votes there are weighed by your TDH.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.ratingsBody: Rep and NIC are ratings collectors give each other. You can give up to your TDH, plus any xTDH another holder grants you, in each.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.levelBody: Your Level grows with your TDH, any xTDH granted to you, and the Rep others give you.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.validatorsBo: Validators will weigh each identity by its TDH when they sign each day's result. The software is at {version}, and nothing signs yet.
explained.tdh.overview.number.label: Your number
explained.tdh.overview.number.title: Is my number right?
explained.tdh.overview.number.body: Explain my TDH shows every copy that counted for you: copies × whole days × rate, your boost, and whether your record was equal in today's comparison.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.input: A profile, an ENS name or an address
explained.tdh.overview.explain.placehold: A profile, ENS name or address
explained.tdh.overview.explain.total: Base {base} × boost {boost} = {total}, in the result dated {date}.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.included: The Rust core, the Python reference and 6529.io gave it the same TDH in the result dated {date}.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.notChecke: 6529.io computed this record at block {block}; the latest comparison checked block {cutoff}.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.error: 6529.io did not answer. Try again in a moment.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.empty: This record holds no card that counts.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.newBody: No result has counted this wallet yet, and that is expected. Your copy of #{card} arrived {arrived}. The result dated {gapDate} found {gap}: not a whole day. The result dated {firstDate}, published about {publish}, counts its first whole day and adds {rate}; each day after adds {rate} more.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.timeline: Each line is a daily snapshot at midnight UTC. A copy counts a day only when it has been held a whole day at a snapshot.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.timelineA: A timeline of daily snapshots, the copy's arrival, and the first snapshot that counts a whole day.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.noneTitle: No wallet found by that name.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.noneBody: Check the spelling, or paste the address. If the wallet received its first card today, it appears in a result once it has held the card for a whole day.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.why: Why did my TDH change? Pick what happened
explained.tdh.overview.know.label: How we know
explained.tdh.overview.know.title: Checked every day, and published with the files to check it.
explained.tdh.overview.know.body: Each rung rules out more than the one above it. The blue line shows how far the evidence reaches today; everything below it is decided or built, and the page says which.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.writtenBody: P26 states the rules exactly enough that separately written programs agree to the unit.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.provedBody: Lean proofs of key properties of the rules, each with what it does not cover.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.dailyBody: Two separately written programs equal 6529.io on every identity.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.inputsBody: Today the history is read as public log servers report it. 6529's own Ethereum node is built.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.zkBody: Proof A proved the day of {date}, and mainnet's SP1 verifier accepts it in a read-only call. Proof B has not proved that day.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.recordedBody: A contract that accepts a day only with both proofs. Tested on a copy of mainnet; not deployed.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.signedBody: Each validator computes the day with two programs and signs only if they agree.
explained.tdh.overview.know.fail1: the public log servers reported Ethereum's history wrongly, the same way to every program, or
explained.tdh.overview.know.fail2: the rules themselves say something other than what 6529 means them to say.
explained.tdh.overview.know.closedBy: rungs {inputs} and {proofs}. The daily check cannot see either.
explained.tdh.overview.know.candour: A green day is a strong check, not a proof. The daily check says exactly how far it goes.
explained.tdh.overview.index.label: In this chapter
explained.tdh.overview.index.start: If you hold a card, start at {hold}. If you came to check the numbers, start at {check}.
explained.tdh.overview.index.how: Time, rarity, collections and you, each with a model you can move.
explained.tdh.overview.index.wallets: Why your number changed, and how up to four wallets count as one.
explained.tdh.overview.index.check: Today's result, what it shows and does not, and a receipt for every day.
explained.tdh.overview.index.sure: What is proved, what is tested, and what is not.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.feedBody: index.json, written {written}; read {read}. Each day file's SHA-256 is checked against the index when the page reads it.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.rulesBody: P26, TDH v1.4 ({repo} {commit}), in 6529's private design record; restated in full on the Specification page.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.decisionsBody: D112, D119, D128, D136 and D137, from the decision record through {newest}.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.figuresBody: Computed in your browser by the TDH v1.4 engine, which passes every in-scope vector of P26's {vectors}; CI reruns them on every change.
